title: Designing Medical Chatbots where Accuracy and Acceptability are in Conflict: An Exploratory, Vignette-based Study in Urban India
reasoning: The paper is an exploratory human-computer interaction (HCI) study that examines user perceptions and acceptance of medical chatbot advice in India. It focuses on the conflict between clinical guidelines and sociocultural treatment norms (like antibiotic overuse). It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as primary components.
